paper.title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale

result.summary: 本文探索将标准 Transformer 直接应用于图像识别，把图像切分为固定大小的图像块并作为序列输入 Transformer 编码器 [S1.p3]。作者提出 Vision Transformer（ViT），除初始的图像块提取外不引入图像特有的归纳偏置 [S5.p1]。实验表明，在大规模数据上预训练后，ViT 在多个图像分类基准上达到或超过当时最优的卷积网络，同时预训练所需计算资源更少 [S4.p1][S4.T2]。作者认为这种简单且可扩展的策略在大规模预训练配合下效果出人意料地好 [S5.p1]。

research_question.text: 在计算机视觉领域，卷积架构仍占主导地位，而将自注意力与 CNN 结合或完全替换卷积的模型，由于使用专门的注意力模式，尚未能在现代硬件加速器上有效扩展 [S1.p2]。本文受 Transformer 在 NLP 中扩展成功的启发，尝试以尽可能少的修改将标准 Transformer 直接应用于图像 [S1.p3]。

evidence.quote: In computer vision, however, convolutional architectures remain dominant.
The latter models, while theoretically efficient, have not yet been scaled effectively on modern hardware accelerators due to the use of specialized attention patterns.
Inspired by the Transformer scaling successes in NLP, we experiment with applying a standard Transformer directly to images, with the fewest possible modifications.

method.text: ViT 将图像切分为固定大小的图像块，对每个图像块做线性嵌入并加入位置嵌入，然后把得到的向量序列送入标准 Transformer 编码器 [S3.F1]。为进行分类，作者在序列中加入一个可学习的“分类标记” [S3.F1]。具体地，图像被重塑为展平的二维图像块序列，图像块经可训练线性投影映射到维度 D，作为 Transformer 的输入 [S3.SS1.p1]。

evidence.quote: We split an image into fixed-size patches, linearly embed each of them, add position embeddings, and feed the resulting sequence of vectors to a standard Transformer encoder.
In order to perform classification, we use the standard approach of adding an extra learnable “classification token” to the sequence.
we reshape the image $\mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times C}$ into a sequence of flattened 2D patches $\mathbf{x}_{p}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times(P^{2}\cdot C)}$
we flatten the patches and map to $D$ dimensions with a trainable linear projection (Eq. 1).

experiments.text: 作者在 ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet（1k 类、1.3M 图像）、ImageNet-21k（21k 类、14M 图像）和 JFT（18k 类、303M 高分辨率图像）上预训练，并将模型迁移到 ImageNet、CIFAR-10/100、Oxford-IIIT Pets 和 Oxford Flowers-102 等基准 [S4.SS1.p1]。作者比较了 ResNet、ViT 和混合模型，并在不同规模的数据集上预训练以理解各模型的数据需求 [S4.p1]。此外还进行了自监督的初步实验 [S4.p1]。

evidence.quote: we use the ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet dataset with 1k classes and 1.3M images
its superset ImageNet-21k with 21k classes and 14M images, and JFT with 18k classes and 303M high-resolution images.

We transfer the models trained on these dataset to several benchmark tasks: ImageNet on the original validation labels and the cleaned-up ReaL labels, CIFAR-10/100, Oxford-IIIT Pets, and Oxford Flowers-102.
We evaluate the representation learning capabilities of ResNet, Vision Transformer (ViT), and the hybrid.
To understand the data requirements of each model, we pre-train on datasets of varying size and evaluate many benchmark tasks.
Lastly, we perform a small experiment using self-supervision, and show that self-supervised ViT holds promise for the future.

findings.text: 在 JFT-300M 上预训练的 ViT 在所有数据集上优于基于 ResNet 的基线，且预训练所需计算资源大幅更少 [S4.T2]。在公共 ImageNet-21k 上预训练的 ViT 表现也不错 [S4.T2]。最佳模型在 ImageNet 上达到 88.55%、ImageNet-ReaL 上 90.72%、CIFAR-100 上 94.55%、VTAB 19 项任务上 77.63% 的准确率 [S1.p5]。在相同计算预算下，ViT 通常优于 ResNet；混合模型在较小模型规模上优于纯 Transformer，但差距在更大模型上消失 [S4.F5]。自监督预训练的较小 ViT-B/16 在 ImageNet 上达到 79.9%，比从头训练提升 2%，但仍落后监督预训练 4% [S4.SS6.p1]。

evidence.quote: Vision Transformer models pre-trained on the JFT-300M dataset outperform ResNet-based baselines on all datasets, while taking substantially less computational resources to pre-train.
ViT pre-trained on the smaller public ImageNet-21k dataset performs well too.
the best model reaches the accuracy of $88.55\%$ on ImageNet, $90.72\%$ on ImageNet-ReaL, $94.55\%$ on CIFAR-100, and $77.63\%$ on the VTAB suite of 19 tasks.
Vision Transformers generally outperform ResNets with the same computational budget.
Hybrids improve upon pure Transformers for smaller model sizes, but the gap vanishes for larger models.
our smaller ViT-B/16 model achieves 79.9% accuracy on ImageNet, a significant improvement of 2% to training from scratch, but still 4% behind supervised pre-training.

limitations.text: 作者将对比式预训练的探索留作未来工作 [S4.SS6.p1]。

evidence.quote: We leave exploration of contrastive pre-training to future work.
